text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to run commands in this session, so please run it to confirm. I found each bug by reading the code against the tests.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** the borrow limit `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the days late. It now multiplies (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma". I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count aren't specified anywhere, so I made them up.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
